title: A Undertow for the Weather
author: Lior Sandoval
blurb: Dominic Nystrom, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
